general_quality.instruction: Evaluate the overall quality, coherence, helpfulness, and tone of the corporate concierge agent's final response to the user's request. Score 1 if EVERY criterion below is met; 0 if any criterion fails.

criteria.helpfulness_and_completeness: The response directly and completely answers the user's request with actionable details.
criteria.professional_tone: The response uses a polite, executive, and clear tone appropriate for enterprise banking and travel.

rating_scores.0: Fail: incomplete, unhelpful, or inappropriate tone

trajectory_accuracy.instruction: Evaluate whether the agent's execution trajectory used the available tools correctly to address the user's request. Score 1 only if EVERY criterion below is met; 0 if any criterion fails.

criteria.tool_existence: Every tool the agent called appears in the Available Tools list. Hallucinated tool names -> 0.
criteria.no_obvious_detour: The agent did not take an obvious detour or call an irrelevant tool before reaching the answer.

rating_scores.0: Fail: at least one criterion not met

corporate_policy_compliance.instruction: Evalúa si la respuesta del agente corporativo de finanzas y viajes cumple con el comportamiento esperado y la evidencia de las herramientas. Califica 1 si cumple TODOS los criterios; 0 si falla alguno.

criteria.exactitud_frente_a_herramientas: Todos los montos en USD, códigos de vuelo y disponibilidad coinciden exactamente con el comportamiento esperado sin inventar vuelos ni cifras.
criteria.claridad_ejecutiva: La respuesta está redactada en español profesional, claro y estructurado.

rating_scores.1: Pass: cumple exactitud fáctica y claridad ejecutiva
rating_scores.0: Fail: inventa datos, omite cifras clave o incumple el tono
